sources.role: Complete existing original territorial products and their recorded URLs, licenses, bytes and represented-date claims
sources.vintage: Heterogeneous reference snapshots recorded per retained product; not a verified present-day or historical jurisdiction date

license.terms: Product-specific source licenses are preserved verbatim in the retained catalogue; no raw original payload is redistributed by this queue.

sources.restoration: Restore all original parts by their existing repository paths, encoded/decoded hashes and concatenated whole-product hash in retained-source-catalogue.json. The measurement streamed all 368 products.
sources.limit: The compact gate authenticates the existing corpus catalogue and result blocks, not a new full independent scientific approval of every original territorial source.

sources.role: Original retained GSHHG native member and complete supported hierarchy/source frames
sources.vintage: Retained GSHHG source-relative reference; not present-day perfect physical ground truth

license.terms: Reuse the existing repository source custody and its retained terms; no original GSHHG archive is copied here.

sources.restoration: Use the pinned existing native custody index and source metadata paths from physical-source-summary.json and physical-package-queue.json.
sources.limit: Antarctic levels are excluded by policy and one malformed level-one source remains unknown; physical support is not territorial assignment authority.

methods.description: Hash-authenticated complete retained source products, current source-member/semantic lineage, exact binary64 native scanline intervals, owner-zero intersection, global interval sweep and disjoint source/cause package selectors. Physical source hierarchy joined independently. Source003-type original gap masks are not discovery operands.
methods.software: Node v24.19.0; Python standard library; Shapely2.1.2 only for existing source periodic-frame normalization and independent bounded geometric checks
methods.units: Native lattice cells and sparse half-open row intervals; source feature and package counts; seconds and RSS bytes. No physical area inferred.
methods.crs: Retained source longitude/latitude contract and pinned native latitude table; documented physical periodic frames
methods.area_method: Not computed; native cells are not equal-area
methods.distance_method: Not used for assignment; no nearest-owner inference

conclusions.text: The retained-source and physical-only work domains are represented by disjoint executable interval packages, with uncertainty and domain exclusions explicit.
Source-specific repair authority, current ownership applicability and source disagreements remain package-level work; the queue does not approve repairs.
